memberships.organization: The Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)
memberships.description: The Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) is the world's largest technical professional organization dedicated to advancing technology for the benefit of humanity.
IEEE Consumer Technology Society (CTSoc) is a specialized technical society within IEEE focusing on interdisciplinary consumer technologies, smart devices, artificial intelligence, and big data.

memberships.organization: Asosiasi Pendidikan Tinggi Informatika dan Komputer (APTIKOM)
memberships.description: The Indonesian Association of Higher Education in Computer Science (APTIKOM) is an association or community of universities in Indonesia that have study programs related to the field of informatics and computer science (commonly known as information technology).
IAENG is the largest non-profit international association for all engineers and computer scientists. IAENG publishes scholarly peer-reviewed open access.
